verdict.rationale: Bevy uses plain Rust as its 'scripting' layer, and docs plus community comments confirm the ECS API is idiomatic, fully native Rust with no macros/lifetimes needed (bevy-docs-14, bevy-docs-20, bevy-comm-3, bevy-comm-4), which is a strong productivity/API-exposure signal. However, there is no evidence at all of a dedicated debugger or debugging workflow behind this scripting layer, and community feedback flags limited/out-of-date docs and frequent breaking changes as productivity friction (bevy-comm-14, bevy-comm-15, bevy-comm-12). Missing for 10: explicit debugger/debugging-tool evidence, confirmation of full API surface coverage beyond ECS basics, and independent hands-on accounts of debugging Bevy games.
